report: A rural road built by a municipality runs across the slope above the national highway. Cracks have appeared and debris is falling onto the highway.

reasons: no optical or radar observation inside the freshness window

routing.office: Ward Committee under the Ward Chair; municipal executive (Mayor/Chair) above it
routing.legal_basis: LGOA 2074 s.12(2)(c)(23) 'Remove floods, landslides in the roads'; s.12(2)(c)(21)-(22); Constitution of Nepal 2072 Sch. 8 item 11 read with LGOA 2074 s.11(1) and s.11(2)(ट)
routing.rationale: The report indicates a rural road built by a municipality that is affected by cracks and debris falling onto the highway. This suggests a need for immediate maintenance or repair.
notes: Ward road duties are defaults applying until the municipal executive prescribes otherwise. Internal branch names vary between municipalities.

dispatch.advisory_ne:
पहिरो जोखिम सूचना — वर्षाका कारण ढलान संवेदनशील बनेको छ, तर पछिल्लो अवलोकन उपलब्ध छैन। स्याटेलाइटले यो ढलान हेर्न सकेको छैन, त्यसैले परिवर्तनको पुष्टि गर्न सकिँदैन।

स्थान: Ward 11, Thakre, DHADING, Province 3
मिति: 2024-09-28

वर्षाको अवस्था: थ्रेसहोल्ड नाघ्यो (पाँचपोखरी थाङपाल, सिन्धुपाल्चोक) — 24 घण्टामा 69/119 मिमि, 48 घण्टामा 190/142 मिमि, 72 घण्टामा 190/158 मिमि, 240 घण्टामा 245/215 मिमि
किन महत्त्वपूर्ण: यो अवस्थामा ढलान अस्थिर हुन सक्छ, तर हामीसँग पछिल्लो उपग्रह प्रमाण छैन — त्यसैले यो सूचना जोखिमको संकेत हो, पुष्टि होइन।
पहिले जाँच्नुहोस्: Ward 11, Thakre, DHADING, Province 3 को ढलान; माथिल्लो ढलानको जल-निकास
जिम्मेवार निकाय: Rural/Urban Municipality (Ward Committee) (Ward Committee under the Ward Chair; municipal executive (Mayor/Chair) above it)
कानुनी आधार: LGOA 2074 s.12(2)(c)(23) 'Remove floods, landslides in the roads'; s.12(2)(c)(21)-(22); Constitution of Nepal 2072 Sch. 8 item 11 read with LGOA 2074 s.11(1) and s.11(2)(ट)
